name: Aroma-Zone
desc: French natural beauty, wellness and selfcare brand selling essential oils, natural ingredients and cosmetics online and in stores.
ownership: subsidiary of Partners Group (majority stake acquired on behalf of its clients); Eurazeo reinvested via Eurazeo Capital V
capacity_detail: Sale of Eurazeo's stake to Partners Group valued Aroma-Zone at about EUR 2B (USD 2.31B) including debt (Aug 2026 reports); completed 17 Nov 2026 with EUR 577M gross proceeds to Eurazeo
markets: France, with more than 30 stores and new stores planned in France, Belgium, Italy and the UK; over five million active customers

signals.raise: Partners Group completed purchase of Eurazeo's stake, Eurazeo reinvesting EUR 228M (Nov 2026; https://finyear.com/eurazeo-finalise-la-cession-de-sa-participation-dans-aroma-zone/)
signals.regions: New stores planned in Belgium, Italy and the UK (Aug 2026; https://beautymatter.com/articles/eurazeo-in-talks-to-sell-aroma-zone-stake-in-2-3-billion-deal)

rationale: Fast-growing French beauty brand expanding across Europe under new owner; F1's European fan base and growing female audience suit its customers.
